notes.title: Content Update #1 - Version 1.2A now available!
notes.content:
Hey there,

I just set up the first content update for the game (v1.2A). As some people were unhappy with the real ending I decided to add a little bit more thrill to it.
Also a few other improvements were done.

Changelog:
- Extended Ending no. 3 (True ending/boss)
- Added alternative Chapter 2 (random)
- Chapter 3 and 4 loaded from menu are more obviously leading you to the same two endings now
- Several other improvements, such as adding chapter popups etc.

Hope youll enjoy everything. :)

Cheers, Fabian

notes.title: Update / Important Info
notes.content:
Hey guys,

First of all: I am sorry that there were some bugs... and that they caused troubles to some of you.

Good news: They are fixed. A new version is now available. (1.1A)
Make sure you have it by checking the readme file in your local folder.

Changelog:
- Fixed problem with door handle being displaced or not collectable
- Fixed that problem where an old map file was loaded (lighting/paths rebuild...)
- Minor improvements

To those who encountered that bug where a wrong map file was loaded it may be necessary to download the complete game again after deleting local files... but I can`t tell for sure. Maybe the update is enough.

I am doing my best to deliver content as perfect as possible for an one man studio. Also my connection sucks hard, so for some reason the upload from my place always fails... that means I literally have to deliver the game... by driving to another place with a better connection... on my birthday. Thats why it took so long for me to bring an update on this.

I hope you understand.

And please... help me by posting bugs in the forums and not giving a bad rating and telling me theres a bug. Thats not helpful at all... 

I will keep you posted on further updates as I am still planning to add more to the game. I am already working on that.

Cheers, Fabian (pheenix93)
